parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
How many items to return in one page, from 1 to 100. A number outside that range is clamped to
it rather than rejected.

When `limit` is missing or is not a number, a page holds up to 2,000 items, which for most lists
means everything. This default may be lowered, so pass `limit` and follow the `Link` header.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Return the page of results that follows this cursor.

Cursors are opaque — do not construct, parse or store them. Take the value from the `next` link in
the `Link` response header of the previous page. Sending both `after` and `before` is not
supported; `before` wins.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Return the page of results that precedes this cursor.

Cursors are opaque — take the value from the `prev` link in the `Link` response header rather than
building one yourself.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description:
The organization the request applies to. Your API key is bound to one organization; requests for
any other organization are rejected. You can find the id in the dashboard, or on the organization
object returned by this API.
